about: Every admin SPA route and every mobile screen, with the E2E tests covering it or why it has none (docs/decisions/2026-10-18-e2e-coverage-gate.md). Each entry has exactly one of tests (web: e2e/web/tests specs), flows (mobile: jarvis-node-mobile .maestro/ files), manual (why it is checked by hand) or pending (the item that will add its test). web/admin/src/coverage.test.tsx (CI) and tools/e2emobile (scripts/e2e mobile) fail when a route or screen has no entry, or an entry no route or screen. tools/e2emobile also fails when a pending entry names a flow file that exists, or a flow it runs (not tagged skip) is listed by no entry.
